name: pstack-zcode
description: Plugins for pstack-zcode, the ZCode adaptation of Lauren @poteto's pstack workflow.

plugins.name: pstack-zcode
plugins.description: The whole pstack collection for ZCode: all 54 skills plus an optional resident-mode SessionStart hook, off by default. One install carries everything.

plugins.name: pstack-resident
plugins.description: The resident-mode hook alone, for users who installed the skills with npx. Injects the condensed poteto-mode summary where poteto-mode is reachable. Skip this if you installed the pstack-zcode plugin.
